flags.message: claude-baseline (forward) web-fetched this application's own live supremecourt.gov docket at 2026-11-03T20:46Z, the same day the Chief Justice denied it. Only a result digest was captured. The candidate disclosed that no disposition appeared, and its timing forecast is consistent with that, so I graded the leakage not_applicable / not suspected. Noted because a forward cell run on the resolution date can see the outcome.

The candidates disagree about the statpack's interim finer counts. claude-baseline reported finer_resolved=0 and finer_unread non-zero. gemini-baseline reported populated finer counts that differ from the current statpack.json (e.g. OT2025 20/223 vs 19/218). The pack may have been rebuilt between prediction and evaluation. The harness-stamped interim baseline is unaffected, but maintainers may want the statpack digest pinned on interim predictions.
